function computePlan(){
  const d = state.profile;
  const kg = d.units === 'imp' ? +d.w * 0.4536 : +d.w;
  const cm = d.units === 'imp' ? (+d.ft * 12 + (+d.inch || 0)) * 2.54 : +d.h;
  const bmr  = 10*kg + 6.25*cm - 5*(+d.age) + (d.sex === 'm' ? 5 : -161);
  const tdee = bmr * d.activity;
  const tune = GOAL_TUNING[d.goal];
  let kcal = Math.round(tdee * (1 + tune.adj) / 10) * 10;
  const floored = kcal < 1300;
  kcal = Math.max(kcal, 1300);
  const protein = Math.round(kg * tune.prot);
  const fat     = Math.round(kcal * 0.27 / 9);
  const carbs   = Math.max(Math.round((kcal - protein*4 - fat*9) / 4), 0);

  /* The weekdays the user picked, if they picked any. Sorted so the ordered
     focus-area sequence from SPLIT_TEMPLATES lands across the week in calendar
     order — which keeps the sequence itself identical to the default, only the
     weekdays move. Profiles saved before the picker existed have no
     trainingDays and fall back to the original fixed pattern unchanged. */
  const chosen = Array.isArray(d.trainingDays) && d.trainingDays.length === +d.days
    ? [...d.trainingDays].sort((x, y) => x - y)
    : null;
  const pattern = chosen || DAY_PATTERNS[d.days] || DAY_PATTERNS[4];
  const template = (SPLIT_TEMPLATES[d.goal] || SPLIT_TEMPLATES.maintain)[d.days]
                || (SPLIT_TEMPLATES[d.goal] || SPLIT_TEMPLATES.maintain)[4];

  /* `seen` tallies each shelf as it is used so repeats land on a different
     session; pickFrom owns the increment because only it knows which shelf a
     slot finally came from. */
  const avail = availableEquip(d), avoid = avoidTraits(d);
  const seen = {}, subs = [], trainingDays = [];
  pattern.forEach((dayIdx, slot) => {
    const cat = template[slot % template.length];
    const picked = pickFrom(d.goal, cat, seen, avail, avoid);
    if (!picked) return;          /* unreachable — the last rung is bodyweight-only */
    if (picked.substituted) subs.push(picked.substituted);
    trainingDays.push({ dayIdx, g:picked.realGoal, cat:picked.realCat, w:picked.w });
  });
  /* one line per distinct swap, not one per affected day */
  const substitutions = [...new Map(subs.map(s => [s.from + '>' + s.to, s])).values()];

  const schedule = DAYNAMES.map((day, i) => {
    const t = trainingDays.find(x => x.dayIdx === i);
    return t ? { day, g:t.g, cat:t.cat, w:t.w } : { day, rest:true };
  });

  /* summary of what the week covers, for the plan page */
  const labelFor = c => c === 'conditioning' ? 'Cardio' : (CAT_LABEL[c] || c);
  const coverage = [...new Set(trainingDays.map(t => labelFor(t.cat)))];

  /* ---- premium metrics ---- */
  /* body context */
  const hM = cm / 100;
  const bmi = kg / (hM*hM);
  const bmiCat = bmi < 18.5 ? 'underweight' : bmi < 25 ? 'healthy range'
               : bmi < 30 ? 'overweight' : 'obese range';

  /* weekly training load */
  const weeklyMinutes = trainingDays.reduce((s,t) => s + t.w.duration, 0);
  const weeklyBurn    = trainingDays.reduce((s,t) => s + t.w.burn, 0);

  /* energy balance & timeline projection */
  const dailyDelta = kcal - tdee;                 /* +surplus / −deficit */
  /* ~7700 kcal per kg of body mass */
  const weeklyKg = (dailyDelta * 7) / 7700;
  const absWeeklyKg = Math.abs(weeklyKg);
  const weeklyChange = absWeeklyKg < 0.01 ? 0
    : (d.units === 'imp' ? absWeeklyKg * 2.2046 : absWeeklyKg);
  const changeUnit = d.units === 'imp' ? 'lb' : 'kg';

  /* a 12-week horizon projection */
  const horizonWeeks = 12;
  const projKg = weeklyKg * horizonWeeks;
  const projChange = Math.abs(d.units==='imp' ? projKg*2.2046 : projKg);
  const projDir = kcal > tdee ? 'gain' : kcal < tdee ? 'lose' : 'maintain';

  /* per-meal macro split (3 meals + 1 snack model) */
  const meals = [
    { name:'Breakfast', pct:.28 },
    { name:'Lunch',     pct:.32 },
    { name:'Dinner',    pct:.30 },
    { name:'Snack',     pct:.10 },
  ].map(m => ({
    name:m.name,
    kcal:Math.round(kcal*m.pct/10)*10,
    p:Math.round(protein*m.pct),
    c:Math.round(carbs*m.pct),
    f:Math.round(fat*m.pct),
  }));

  /* hydration scales with training load */
  const waterL = Math.round((kg*35/1000 + weeklyMinutes/7*0.012) * 10) / 10;

  /* protein per meal target for absorption */
  const proteinPerMeal = Math.round(protein / 4);

  return {
    kcal, floored, tdee:Math.round(tdee), bmr:Math.round(bmr),
    protein, carbs, fat, proteinPerMeal,
    proteinCal: protein*4, carbCal: carbs*4, fatCal: fat*9,
    waterL,
    steps:  d.goal === 'lose' ? '10,000' : '8,000',
    schedule, coverage, substitutions,
    bmi: Math.round(bmi*10)/10, bmiCat,
    weeklyMinutes, weeklyBurn,
    dailyDelta: Math.round(dailyDelta),
    weeklyChange: Math.round(weeklyChange*100)/100, changeUnit,
    projChange: Math.round(projChange*10)/10, projDir, horizonWeeks,
    meals,
  };
}
